name: Shirakawa Hotaru
source:
The primary heroine of Memories Off 2nd, Hotaru is in her third year at Hamasaki High School. She often acts childish and immature, and is sometimes an airhead. Her favourite hobby is the piano. Her best friend is [url=/c11628]Tomoe[/url], and [url=/c11635]Ken[/url] is her boyfriend.

[Taken From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Memories_Off_2nd]Wikipedia[/url].]
